CVE-2005-3622.title: phpMyAdmin 2.7.0-beta1 and earlier allows remote attackers to obt ...
CVE-2005-3622.description: phpMyAdmin 2.7.0-beta1 and earlier allows remote attackers to obtain the full path of the server via direct requests to multiple scripts in the libraries directory.

CVE-2007-4306.title: Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in phpMyAdmin ...
CVE-2007-4306.description: Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in phpMyAdmin 2.10.3 allow remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the (1) unlim_num_rows, (2) sql_query, or (3) pos parameter to (a) tbl_export.php; the (4) session_max_rows or (5) pos parameter to (b) sql.php; the (6) username parameter to (c) server_privileges.php; or the (7) sql_query parameter to (d) main.php.  NOTE: vector 5 might be a regression or incomplete fix for CVE-2006-6942.7.

CVE-2020-11441.title: phpMyAdmin 5.0.2 allows CRLF injection, as demonstrated by %0D%0A ...
CVE-2020-11441.description: phpMyAdmin 5.0.2 allows CRLF injection, as demonstrated by %0D%0Astring%0D%0A inputs to login form fields causing CRLF sequences to be reflected on an error page. NOTE: the vendor states "I don't see anything specifically exploitable.

CVE-2025-24529.title: An issue was discovered in phpMyAdmin 5.x before 5.2.2. An XSS vu ...
CVE-2025-24529.description: An issue was discovered in phpMyAdmin 5.x before 5.2.2. An XSS vulnerability has been discovered for the Insert tab.

CVE-2025-24530.title: An issue was discovered in phpMyAdmin 5.x before 5.2.2. An XSS vu ...
CVE-2025-24530.description: An issue was discovered in phpMyAdmin 5.x before 5.2.2. An XSS vulnerability has been discovered for the check tables feature. A crafted table or database name could be used for XSS.

CVE-2025-3573.title: Versions of the package jquery-validation before 1.20.0 are vulne ...
CVE-2025-3573.description: Versions of the package jquery-validation before 1.20.0 are vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in the showLabel() function, which may take input from a user-controlled placeholder value. This value will populate a message via $.validator.messages in a user localizable dictionary.

CVE-2026-119426.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a cross-site request forgery vu ...
CVE-2026-119426.description: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL by bypassing CSRF token checks on non-AJAX POST requests. Attackers can lure authenticated victims into submitting cross-site POSTs carrying sql_query to /sql or /database/sql, running SQL with the victim's database privileges under http or config authentication.

CVE-2026-119427.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability  ...
CVE-2026-119427.description: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability in Designer saveSetting() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL via unescaped json_encode() output. Attackers can send crafted index or value parameters with operation=save_setting_value to /database/designer to overwrite other users' designer settings or run controluser subqueries.

CVE-2026-119428.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a server-side request forgery v ...
CVE-2026-119428.description: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger outbound connections via setup/validate.php, which lacks the setup-disabled guard. Attackers can POST attacker-chosen host and port values reaching Validator::testDBConnection() to open MySQL-protocol connections and probe internal ports using returned error messages.

CVE-2026-119429.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a missing re-authentication vul ...
CVE-2026-119429.description: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a missing re-authentication vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to remove two-factor authentication by posting the 2fa key to /config/set. Attackers holding a hijacked session can submit key=2fa with a null JSON value to SetConfigController, stripping 2FA so later logins require only the MySQL password.
